records.label: Clear 2D character illustration
records.visual_intent: A polished, readable image with controlled line hierarchy, simple value grouping, stable local color, and selective finish serving the chosen whole-image hierarchy.
records.linework: Use clean contour decisions with heavier structural accents and lighter interior lines. Concentrate precision around the forms and relationships carrying the intended effect, including relevant silhouette breaks, structural connections and distinctive design features.
records.shape_language: Build the image from large readable masses, then describe anatomy, covering, clothing, props and environmental structures through deliberate medium and small shape families.
records.value_structure: Organize forms into a small number of clearly separated value groups, distributing local contrast according to the selected focal relationships across the image.
records.color_logic: Keep local colors identifiable through light and shadow. Organize temperature relationships and repeated accents according to the selected color plan; a dominant temperature relationship can unify a composition when that plan calls for it.
records.surface_policy: Describe each surface through shape, edge, value, and highlight behavior appropriate to its material while maintaining one unified illustration finish.
records.lighting_response: Translate the selected light into coherent plane changes, readable cast shadows, controlled reflected fill, and a limited hierarchy of highlights.
records.background_policy: Give the environment or graphic field the prominence, depth and complexity its role in the selected image needs. A character-led portrait can use a quiet field or a simplified setting; a spatial relationship, environmental event or graphic structure can instead carry the main read. Preserve the chosen hierarchy through value grouping, edges and detail allocation.
records.detail_hierarchy: Finish the elements carrying the intended effect and their defining relationships before adding secondary texture. In an identity-led portrait, this can prioritize the eyes, face, distinctive identity features, meaningful hand or prop contact, and primary silhouette. Other depictions assign that precision to their own focal content; body region or background status does not determine priority.
records.rendering: Create a clear polished 2D illustration with decisive silhouette shapes and a compact value plan that carries the selected whole-image hierarchy. Draw the main contours with confident varied weight, using stronger accents at relevant overlaps, contact points, structural connections and focal features. Construct subjects, coverings, clothing, objects and surroundings as connected forms whose internal lines support volume and design. Keep local colors stable across the selected lighting, group shadows into readable families, and place reflected fill where it clarifies important construction. Concentrate edge precision, local contrast and surface accents on the elements carrying the intended effect and their defining relationships. Give the environment its chosen prominence and necessary detail; simplify supporting regions according to their role in this picture. Use highlights selectively according to material and plane orientation. Preserve a unified illustration finish across anatomy, fabric, natural covering, rigid objects, environmental structures and effects while allowing each surface to retain its own tactile behavior.
